SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(ORDER_QUANTITY AS REAL)), 0) FROM ORDERS WHERE STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} AND ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(INVESTED_AMOUNT AS REAL)), 0) FROM POSITIONS WHERE STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} AND ACTIVE = 'Y'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(ORDER_AMOUNT AS REAL)), 0) FROM ORDERS WHERE STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} AND ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POSITIONS WHERE ACTIVE = 'Y'

SELECT ID, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, STOCK_NAME AS stockName, STATUS, PURCHASE_PRICE AS purchasePrice, PURCHASE_QUANTITY AS purchaseQuantity, INVESTED_AMOUNT AS investedAmount, CURRENT_PRICE AS currentPrice, CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT AS currentValuationAmount, PROFIT_RATE AS profitRate, LAST_EVALUATED_PRICE AS lastEvaluatedPrice, STATUS_REFERENCE_PRICE AS statusReferencePrice, GRAY_ENTERED_DATE AS grayEnteredDate, GRAY_TRADING_DAYS AS grayTradingDays, AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE AS averageBuyPrice, REFERENCE_PRICE AS referencePrice, HIGHEST_PRICE AS highestPrice, LOWEST_PRICE AS lowestPrice, HOLDING_QUANTITY AS holdingQuantity, RETURN_RATE AS returnRate, LAST_EVALUATED_AT AS lastEvaluatedAt, FLAT_STARTED_DATE AS flatStartedDate, FLAT_ACTIVE AS flatActive, MARKET_TYPE AS marketType, ACTIVE, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM POSITIONS WHERE STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} AND (MARKET_TYPE = #{marketType} OR MARKET_TYPE IS NULL) AND ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY ID ASC

SELECT ID, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, STOCK_NAME AS stockName, STATUS, PURCHASE_PRICE AS purchasePrice, PURCHASE_QUANTITY AS purchaseQuantity, INVESTED_AMOUNT AS investedAmount, CURRENT_PRICE AS currentPrice, CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT AS currentValuationAmount, PROFIT_RATE AS profitRate, LAST_EVALUATED_PRICE AS lastEvaluatedPrice, STATUS_REFERENCE_PRICE AS statusReferencePrice, GRAY_ENTERED_DATE AS grayEnteredDate, GRAY_TRADING_DAYS AS grayTradingDays, AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE AS averageBuyPrice, REFERENCE_PRICE AS referencePrice, HIGHEST_PRICE AS highestPrice, LOWEST_PRICE AS lowestPrice, HOLDING_QUANTITY AS holdingQuantity, RETURN_RATE AS returnRate, LAST_EVALUATED_AT AS lastEvaluatedAt, FLAT_STARTED_DATE AS flatStartedDate, FLAT_ACTIVE AS flatActive, MARKET_TYPE AS marketType, ACTIVE, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM POSITIONS WHERE ID = #{positionId}

SELECT ID, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, STATUS, PURCHASE_PRICE AS purchasePrice, PURCHASE_QUANTITY AS purchaseQuantity, INVESTED_AMOUNT AS investedAmount, CURRENT_PRICE AS currentPrice, CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT AS currentValuationAmount, PROFIT_RATE AS profitRate, LAST_EVALUATED_PRICE AS lastEvaluatedPrice, STATUS_REFERENCE_PRICE AS statusReferencePrice, GRAY_ENTERED_DATE AS grayEnteredDate, GRAY_TRADING_DAYS AS grayTradingDays, AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE AS averageBuyPrice, REFERENCE_PRICE AS referencePrice, HIGHEST_PRICE AS highestPrice, LOWEST_PRICE AS lowestPrice, HOLDING_QUANTITY AS holdingQuantity, RETURN_RATE AS returnRate, LAST_EVALUATED_AT AS lastEvaluatedAt, FLAT_STARTED_DATE AS flatStartedDate, FLAT_ACTIVE AS flatActive, MARKET_TYPE AS marketType, ACCOUNT_SYNC_SOURCE AS accountSyncSource, LIFECYCLE_KEY AS lifecycleKey, ACTIVE, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM POSITIONS WHERE STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} AND (MARKET_TYPE = #{marketType} OR MARKET_TYPE IS NULL) AND ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ID, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, STOCK_NAME AS stockName, STATUS, PURCHASE_PRICE AS purchasePrice, PURCHASE_QUANTITY AS purchaseQuantity, INVESTED_AMOUNT AS investedAmount, CURRENT_PRICE AS currentPrice, CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT AS currentValuationAmount, PROFIT_RATE AS profitRate, LAST_EVALUATED_PRICE AS lastEvaluatedPrice, STATUS_REFERENCE_PRICE AS statusReferencePrice, GRAY_ENTERED_DATE AS grayEnteredDate, GRAY_TRADING_DAYS AS grayTradingDays, AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE AS averageBuyPrice, REFERENCE_PRICE AS referencePrice, HIGHEST_PRICE AS highestPrice, LOWEST_PRICE AS lowestPrice, HOLDING_QUANTITY AS holdingQuantity, RETURN_RATE AS returnRate, LAST_EVALUATED_AT AS lastEvaluatedAt, FLAT_STARTED_DATE AS flatStartedDate, FLAT_ACTIVE AS flatActive, ACCOUNT_SYNC_SOURCE AS accountSyncSource, LIFECYCLE_KEY AS lifecycleKey, MARKET_TYPE AS marketType, ACTIVE, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM POSITIONS WHERE ACTIVE = 'Y' AND STATUS != 'CLOSED' ORDER BY ID ASC

SELECT p.ID, p.STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, p.STOCK_NAME AS stockName, p.STATUS AS status, p.PURCHASE_PRICE AS purchasePrice, p.PURCHASE_QUANTITY AS purchaseQuantity, p.INVESTED_AMOUNT AS investedAmount, p.CURRENT_PRICE AS currentPrice, p.CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT AS currentValuationAmount, p.PROFIT_RATE AS profitRate, p.LAST_EVALUATED_PRICE AS lastEvaluatedPrice, p.STATUS_REFERENCE_PRICE AS statusReferencePrice, p.GRAY_ENTERED_DATE AS grayEnteredDate, p.GRAY_TRADING_DAYS AS grayTradingDays, p.AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE AS averageBuyPrice, p.REFERENCE_PRICE AS referencePrice, p.HIGHEST_PRICE AS highestPrice, p.LOWEST_PRICE AS lowestPrice, p.HOLDING_QUANTITY AS holdingQuantity, p.RETURN_RATE AS returnRate, p.LAST_EVALUATED_AT AS lastEvaluatedAt, COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(h.OCCURRED_AT) FROM TRADE_LIFECYCLE_HISTORY h WHERE h.LIFECYCLE_ID = p.ID AND ( (p.STATUS = 'WHITE' AND h.EVENT_TYPE IN ('BUY_FILLED', 'WHITE_ENTERED', 'WHITE_RECOVERED', 'ACCOUNT_SYNC_CREATED')) OR (p.STATUS = 'GRAY' AND h.EVENT_TYPE = 'WHITE_TO_GRAY') OR (p.STATUS = 'BLACK' AND h.EVENT_TYPE IN ('BLACK_ENTERED', 'TAKE_PROFIT_TRIGGERED', 'STOP_LOSS_TRIGGERED')) ) ), p.CREATED_AT) AS statusEnteredAt, p.ACTIVE, p.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, p.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS o WHERE o.STOCK_CODE = p.STOCK_CODE AND o.ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' AND o.ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING') ), 0) AS openBuyOrderCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS o WHERE o.STOCK_CODE = p.STOCK_CODE AND o.ORDER_TYPE = 'SELL' AND o.POSITION_ID = p.ID AND o.ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING') ), 0) AS openSellOrderCount FROM POSITIONS p WHERE p.ACTIVE = 'Y' AND p.STATUS != 'CLOSED' ORDER BY CASE p.STATUS WHEN 'BLACK' THEN 0 WHEN 'GRAY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, p.STOCK_CODE ASC
SELECT CASH_BALANCE AS cashBalance, TOTAL_VALUATION_AMOUNT AS totalValuationAmount, CURRENCY_CODE AS currencyCode, SOURCE AS source, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM ACCOUNT_BALANCE WHERE ID = 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ORDER_TYPE = 'SELL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sellSuccessCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS buySuccessCount FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_STATUS = 'FILLED' AND FILLED_AT IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(FILLED_AT) != '' AND julianday(FILLED_AT) >= julianday('now', '-24 hours')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ACCOUNT_BALANCE ( ID, CASH_BALANCE, TOTAL_VALUATION_AMOUNT, CURRENCY_CODE, SOURCE, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( 1, #{cashBalance}, #{totalValuationAmount}, #{currencyCode}, #{source}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT(ID) DO UPDATE SET CASH_BALANCE = excluded.CASH_BALANCE, TOTAL_VALUATION_AMOUNT = excluded.TOTAL_VALUATION_AMOUNT, CURRENCY_CODE = excluded.CURRENCY_CODE, SOURCE = excluded.SOURCE, UPDATED_AT = excluded.UPDATED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT ID, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, STOCK_NAME AS stockName, STATUS, PURCHASE_PRICE AS purchasePrice, PURCHASE_QUANTITY AS purchaseQuantity, INVESTED_AMOUNT AS investedAmount, CURRENT_PRICE AS currentPrice, CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT AS currentValuationAmount, PROFIT_RATE AS profitRate, LAST_EVALUATED_PRICE AS lastEvaluatedPrice, STATUS_REFERENCE_PRICE AS statusReferencePrice, GRAY_ENTERED_DATE AS grayEnteredDate, GRAY_TRADING_DAYS AS grayTradingDays, AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE AS averageBuyPrice, REFERENCE_PRICE AS referencePrice, HIGHEST_PRICE AS highestPrice, LOWEST_PRICE AS lowestPrice, HOLDING_QUANTITY AS holdingQuantity, RETURN_RATE AS returnRate, LAST_EVALUATED_AT AS lastEvaluatedAt, MARKET_TYPE AS marketType, ACTIVE, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM POSITIONS WHERE ACTIVE = 'Y' AND STATUS = 'BLACK' ORDER BY ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POSITIONS ( STOCK_CODE, STOCK_NAME, STATUS, PURCHASE_PRICE, PURCHASE_QUANTITY, INVESTED_AMOUNT, CURRENT_PRICE, CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT, PROFIT_RATE, LAST_EVALUATED_PRICE, STATUS_REFERENCE_PRICE, GRAY_TRADING_DAYS, AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE, REFERENCE_PRICE, HIGHEST_PRICE, LOWEST_PRICE, HOLDING_QUANTITY, RETURN_RATE, LAST_EVALUATED_AT, FLAT_STARTED_DATE, FLAT_ACTIVE, ACCOUNT_SYNC_SOURCE, LIFECYCLE_KEY, MARKET_TYPE, ACTIVE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{stockCode}, #{stockName}, #{status}, #{purchasePrice}, #{purchaseQuantity}, #{investedAmount}, #{currentPrice}, #{currentValuationAmount}, #{profitRate}, #{lastEvaluatedPrice}, #{statusReferencePrice}, #{grayTradingDays}, #{averageBuyPrice}, #{referencePrice}, #{highestPrice}, #{lowestPrice}, #{holdingQuantity}, #{returnRate}, #{lastEvaluatedAt}, null, #{flatActive}, #{accountSyncSource}, #{lifecycleKey}, #{marketType}, 'Y', #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE POSITIONS SET PURCHASE_QUANTITY = #{holdingQuantity}, INVESTED_AMOUNT = #{investedAmount}, HOLDING_QUANTITY = #{holdingQuantity}, CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT = CASE WHEN CURRENT_PRICE IS NULL THEN CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT ELSE CAST(CAST(CURRENT_PRICE AS REAL) * CAST(#{holdingQuantity} AS REAL) AS TEXT) END, RETURN_RATE = CASE WHEN AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE IS NULL OR CAST(AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE AS REAL) <= 0 OR CURRENT_PRICE IS NULL THEN RETURN_RATE ELSE ((CAST(CURRENT_PRICE AS REAL) - CAST(AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE AS REAL)) / CAST(AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE AS REAL)) END, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE ID = #{positionId} AND ACTIVE = 'Y'

UPDATE POSITIONS SET STATUS = #{status}, CURRENT_PRICE = #{currentPrice}, CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT = #{currentValuationAmount}, PROFIT_RATE = #{profitRate}, LAST_EVALUATED_PRICE = #{lastEvaluatedPrice}, STATUS_REFERENCE_PRICE = #{statusReferencePrice}, GRAY_ENTERED_DATE = #{grayEnteredDate}, GRAY_TRADING_DAYS = #{grayTradingDays}, REFERENCE_PRICE = #{referencePrice}, HIGHEST_PRICE = #{highestPrice}, LOWEST_PRICE = #{lowestPrice}, HOLDING_QUANTITY = #{holdingQuantity}, RETURN_RATE = #{returnRate}, LAST_EVALUATED_AT = #{lastEvaluatedAt}, FLAT_STARTED_DATE = #{flatStartedDate}, FLAT_ACTIVE = #{flatActive}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE ID = #{positionId} AND ACTIVE = 'Y'

UPDATE POSITIONS SET STATUS = 'CLOSED', ACTIVE = 'N', CURRENT_PRICE = #{currentPrice}, CURRENT_VALUATION_AMOUNT = #{currentValuationAmount}, PROFIT_RATE = #{profitRate}, RETURN_RATE = #{returnRate}, LAST_EVALUATED_AT = #{closedAt}, UPDATED_AT = #{closedAt} WHERE ID = #{positionId} AND ACTIVE = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER_STATUS FROM ORDERS WHERE IDEMPOTENCY_KEY = #{idempotencyKey} ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ID AS id, POSITION_ID AS positionId, ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, ORDER_SOURCE AS orderSource, LIFECYCLE_KEY AS lifecycleKey FROM ORDERS WHERE IDEMPOTENCY_KEY = #{idempotencyKey} ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ID, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, ORDER_QUANTITY AS orderQuantity, ORDER_PRICE AS orderPrice, ORDER_AMOUNT AS orderAmount, ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, BROKER_ORDER_ID AS brokerOrderId, BROKER_ORDER_ORGNO AS brokerOrderOrgNo, BROKER_STATUS AS brokerStatus, POSITION_ID AS positionId, LAST_BROKER_STATUS_CHECKED_AT AS lastBrokerStatusCheckedAt, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY AS idempotencyKey, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' AND (POSITION_ID IS NULL OR POSITION_ID = 0) AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED') AND (ORDER_STATUS = 'DRY_RUN' OR BROKER_STATUS IN ('OPEN', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED')) ORDER BY ID

SELECT ID, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, BROKER_ORDER_ID AS brokerOrderId, ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' AND STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} AND POSITION_ID IS NULL AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'FILLED') ORDER BY ID ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ID, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, ORDER_QUANTITY AS orderQuantity, ORDER_PRICE AS orderPrice, ORDER_AMOUNT AS orderAmount, ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, BROKER_ORDER_ID AS brokerOrderId, BROKER_ORDER_ORGNO AS brokerOrderOrgNo, BROKER_STATUS AS brokerStatus, POSITION_ID AS positionId, LAST_BROKER_STATUS_CHECKED_AT AS lastBrokerStatusCheckedAt, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY AS idempotencyKey, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_TYPE = 'SELL' AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED') AND (ORDER_STATUS = 'DRY_RUN' OR BROKER_STATUS IN ('OPEN', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED')) ORDER BY ID

SELECT ID, POSITION_ID AS positionId, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, BROKER_ORDER_ID AS brokerOrderId FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_TYPE = 'SELL' AND POSITION_ID = #{positionId} ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ID, POSITION_ID AS positionId, STOCK_CODE AS stockCode, ORDER_TYPE AS orderType, ORDER_QUANTITY AS orderQuantity, ORDER_PRICE AS orderPrice, ORDER_AMOUNT AS orderAmount, ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, BROKER_ORDER_ID AS brokerOrderId, BROKER_ORDER_ORGNO AS brokerOrderOrgNo, BROKER_STATUS AS brokerStatus, CURRENT_PRICE AS currentPrice, CURRENT_PRICE_AT AS currentPriceAt, FILLED_QUANTITY AS filledQuantity, FILLED_PRICE AS filledPrice FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_STATUS IN ('ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED') AND BROKER_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BROKER_ORDER_ID) != '' ORDER BY ID
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDERS SET ORDER_STATUS = 'FILLED', BROKER_STATUS = 'ACCOUNT_SYNC_CONFIRMED', FILLED_QUANTITY = #{filledQuantity}, FILLED_PRICE = #{filledPrice}, REMAINING_QUANTITY = '0', FILLED_AT = COALESCE(FILLED_AT, #{checkedAt}), LAST_BROKER_STATUS_CHECKED_AT = #{checkedAt}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage}, UPDATED_AT = #{checkedAt} WHERE ID = #{orderId} AND ORDER_TYPE IN ('BUY', 'SELL') AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING', 'ACCOUNT_SYNC_FALLBACK')

UPDATE ORDERS SET BROKER_ORDER_ID = #{brokerOrderId}, BROKER_ORDER_ORGNO = #{brokerOrderOrgNo}, ORDER_STATUS = #{orderStatus}, BROKER_STATUS = #{brokerStatus}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE IDEMPOTENCY_KEY = #{idempotencyKey}

UPDATE ORDERS SET ORDER_STATUS = #{orderStatus}, BROKER_STATUS = #{brokerStatus}, FILLED_QUANTITY = COALESCE(#{filledQuantity}, FILLED_QUANTITY), FILLED_PRICE = COALESCE(#{filledPrice}, FILLED_PRICE), REMAINING_QUANTITY = COALESCE(#{remainingQuantity}, REMAINING_QUANTITY), FILLED_AT = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} = 'FILLED' THEN COALESCE(FILLED_AT, #{checkedAt}) ELSE FILLED_AT END, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage}, LAST_BROKER_STATUS_CHECKED_AT = #{checkedAt}, UPDATED_AT = #{checkedAt} WHERE BROKER_ORDER_ID = #{brokerOrderId} AND (#{brokerOrderOrgNo} IS NULL OR BROKER_ORDER_ORGNO = #{brokerOrderOrgNo} OR BROKER_ORDER_ORGNO IS NULL) AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED')

UPDATE ORDERS SET ORDER_STATUS = 'FILLED', BROKER_STATUS = 'KIS_ORDER_NOT_FOUND', FILLED_QUANTITY = COALESCE(FILLED_QUANTITY, ORDER_QUANTITY), FILLED_PRICE = COALESCE(FILLED_PRICE, ORDER_PRICE), REMAINING_QUANTITY = '0', FILLED_AT = COALESCE(FILLED_AT, #{checkedAt}), LAST_BROKER_STATUS_CHECKED_AT = #{checkedAt}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage}, UPDATED_AT = #{checkedAt} WHERE ID = #{orderId} AND ORDER_TYPE = 'SELL' AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS WHERE POSITION_ID = #{positionId} AND ORDER_TYPE = 'SELL' AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS WHERE STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} AND POSITION_ID IS NULL AND ORDER_TYPE = 'SELL' AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDERS ( BROKER_ORDER_ID, POSITION_ID, STOCK_CODE, ORDER_TYPE, ORDER_QUANTITY, ORDER_PRICE, ORDER_AMOUNT, ORDER_STATUS, RETRY_COUNT, ERROR_MESSAGE, REQUESTED_AT, UPDATED_AT, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, DECISION_CYCLE_ID, INSTANCE_ID, MASKED_ACCOUNT, SKIP_REASON, EXIT_REASON, DRY_RUN, CURRENT_PRICE, CURRENT_PRICE_AT, CANDIDATE_RANK, TRADING_VALUE_SCORE, VOLUME_SCORE, VOLATILITY_SCORE, TOTAL_SCORE, POSITION_STATUS, AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE, HIGHEST_PRICE, LOWEST_PRICE, RETURN_RATE, GRAY_TRADING_DAYS, BROKER_ORDER_ORGNO, LIFECYCLE_KEY, ORDER_SOURCE ) VALUES ( #{brokerOrderId}, #{positionId}, #{stockCode}, #{orderType}, #{orderQuantity}, #{orderPrice}, #{orderAmount}, #{orderStatus}, 0, #{errorMessage}, #{requestedAt}, #{requestedAt}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{decisionCycleId}, #{instanceId}, #{maskedAccount}, #{skipReason}, #{exitReason}, #{dryRun}, #{currentPrice}, #{currentPriceAt}, #{candidateRank}, #{tradingValueScore}, #{volumeScore}, #{volatilityScore}, #{totalScore}, #{positionStatus}, #{averageBuyPrice}, #{highestPrice}, #{lowestPrice}, #{returnRate}, #{grayTradingDays}, #{brokerOrderOrgNo}, #{lifecycleKey}, #{orderSource} )
INSERT INTO SCHEDULER_EXECUTION ( SCHEDULER_TYPE, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT, EXECUTION_STATUS, MESSAGE ) VALUES ( #{schedulerType}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{executionStatus}, #{message} )
INSERT INTO AUDIT_LOG ( EVENT_TYPE, STOCK_CODE, details, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{eventType}, #{stockCode}, #{details}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO TRADE_LIFECYCLE_HISTORY ( LIFECYCLE_ID, EVENT_TYPE, PREVIOUS_STATE, NEW_STATE, CURRENT_PRICE, AVERAGE_BUY_PRICE, REFERENCE_PRICE, HIGHEST_PRICE, LOWEST_PRICE, HOLDING_QUANTITY, RETURN_RATE, GRAY_TRADING_DAYS, REASON, ORDER_ID, EXECUTION_ID, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, OCCURRED_AT, LIFECYCLE_KEY ) VALUES ( #{lifecycleId}, #{eventType}, #{previousState}, #{newState}, #{currentPrice}, #{averageBuyPrice}, #{referencePrice}, #{highestPrice}, #{lowestPrice}, #{holdingQuantity}, #{returnRate}, #{grayTradingDays}, #{reason}, #{orderId}, #{executionId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{occurredAt}, #{lifecycleKey} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STOCK_MASTER WHERE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STOCK_MASTER WHERE AND ACTIVE = 'Y' AND TRADABLE = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO STOCK_MASTER ( TYPE, SYMBOL, STOCK_NAME, MARKET_CODE, STANDARD_CODE, SECURITY_GROUP_CODE, ETP, SPAC, TRADABLE, ACTIVE, EXCHANGE_CODE, PRICE_EXCHANGE_CODE, CURRENCY_CODE, LAST_PRICE, MARKET_CAP, TRADING_VOLUME, EXCLUDED_REASON, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, LAST_SYNCED_AT ) VALUES ( 'DOMESTIC', #{symbol}, #{stockName}, #{marketCode}, #{standardCode}, #{securityGroupCode}, CASE WHEN #{etp} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, CASE WHEN #{spac} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, CASE WHEN #{tradable} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, CASE WHEN #{active} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, '', '', '', #{lastPrice}, #{marketCap}, #{tradingVolume}, #{excludedReason}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{lastSyncedAt} ) ON CONFLICT(TYPE, SYMBOL, MARKET_CODE, EXCHANGE_CODE) DO UPDATE SET STOCK_NAME = excluded.STOCK_NAME, STANDARD_CODE = excluded.STANDARD_CODE, SECURITY_GROUP_CODE = excluded.SECURITY_GROUP_CODE, ETP = excluded.ETP, SPAC = excluded.SPAC, TRADABLE = excluded.TRADABLE, ACTIVE = excluded.ACTIVE, LAST_PRICE = excluded.LAST_PRICE, MARKET_CAP = excluded.MARKET_CAP, TRADING_VOLUME = excluded.TRADING_VOLUME, EXCLUDED_REASON = excluded.EXCLUDED_REASON, UPDATED_AT = excluded.UPDATED_AT, LAST_SYNCED_AT = excluded.LAST_SYNCED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT m.ID, m.SYMBOL, m.STOCK_NAME AS stockName, m.MARKET_CODE AS marketCode, m.SECURITY_GROUP_CODE AS securityGroupCode, m.ETP, m.SPAC, CAST(COALESCE(m.LAST_PRICE, '0') AS TEXT) AS lastPrice, CAST(COALESCE(m.MARKET_CAP, '0') AS TEXT) AS marketCap, CAST(COALESCE(m.TRADING_VOLUME, '0') AS TEXT) AS tradingVolume, m.LAST_SELECTED_AT AS lastSelectedAt, m.LAST_BUY_ATTEMPT_AT AS lastBuyAttemptAt, m.LAST_BUY_SUCCESS_AT AS lastBuySuccessAt, m.RETRY_AFTER AS retryAfter, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POSITIONS p WHERE p.STOCK_CODE = m.SYMBOL AND p.ACTIVE = 'Y' ), 0) AS completedBuyCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS o WHERE o.STOCK_CODE = m.SYMBOL AND o.ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' AND o.ORDER_STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING') ), 0) AS pendingBuyCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS r WHERE r.STOCK_CODE = m.SYMBOL AND r.ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' AND r.ORDER_STATUS = 'ORDERING' ), 0) AS reservedBuyCount, CAST(COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(CAST(COALESCE(p.INVESTED_AMOUNT, '0') AS REAL)) FROM POSITIONS p WHERE p.STOCK_CODE = m.SYMBOL AND p.ACTIVE = 'Y' ), 0) AS TEXT) AS totalInvestedAmount, CAST(COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(CAST(COALESCE(o.ORDER_AMOUNT, '0') AS REAL)) FROM ORDERS o WHERE o.STOCK_CODE = m.SYMBOL AND o.ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' AND o.ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING') ), 0) AS TEXT) AS pendingInvestmentAmount FROM STOCK_MASTER m WHERE AND m.ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.TRADABLE = 'Y' AND m.SYMBOL IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(m.SYMBOL) != ''
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO STOCK_DASHBOARD ( TYPE, SYMBOL, MARKET_CODE, EXCHANGE_CODE, RANK_NO, STOCK_NAME, CANDIDATE_SCORE, PURCHASE_ZONE, DASHBOARD_STATUS, LAST_PRICE, COMPLETED_BUY_COUNT, PENDING_BUY_COUNT, RESERVED_BUY_COUNT, CURRENT_DUPLICATE_COUNT, MAXIMUM_DUPLICATE_COUNT, REMAINING_DUPLICATE_COUNT, TOTAL_INVESTED_AMOUNT, PENDING_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT, PURCHASABLE, EXCLUSION_REASON, LAST_SELECTED_AT, LAST_BUY_SUCCESS_AT, RETRY_AFTER, EVALUATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( 'DOMESTIC', #{symbol}, #{marketCode}, '', #{rankNo}, #{stockName}, #{candidateScore}, #{purchaseZone}, #{dashboardStatus}, #{lastPrice}, #{completedBuyCount}, #{pendingBuyCount}, #{reservedBuyCount}, #{currentDuplicateCount}, #{maximumDuplicateCount}, #{remainingDuplicateCount}, #{totalInvestedAmount}, #{pendingInvestmentAmount}, CASE WHEN #{purchasable} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, #{exclusionReason}, #{lastSelectedAt}, #{lastBuySuccessAt}, #{retryAfter}, #{evaluatedAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT(TYPE, SYMBOL, MARKET_CODE, EXCHANGE_CODE) DO UPDATE SET RANK_NO = excluded.RANK_NO, STOCK_NAME = excluded.STOCK_NAME, CANDIDATE_SCORE = excluded.CANDIDATE_SCORE, PURCHASE_ZONE = excluded.PURCHASE_ZONE, DASHBOARD_STATUS = excluded.DASHBOARD_STATUS, LAST_PRICE = excluded.LAST_PRICE, COMPLETED_BUY_COUNT = excluded.COMPLETED_BUY_COUNT, PENDING_BUY_COUNT = excluded.PENDING_BUY_COUNT, RESERVED_BUY_COUNT = excluded.RESERVED_BUY_COUNT, CURRENT_DUPLICATE_COUNT = excluded.CURRENT_DUPLICATE_COUNT, MAXIMUM_DUPLICATE_COUNT = excluded.MAXIMUM_DUPLICATE_COUNT, REMAINING_DUPLICATE_COUNT = excluded.REMAINING_DUPLICATE_COUNT, TOTAL_INVESTED_AMOUNT = excluded.TOTAL_INVESTED_AMOUNT, PENDING_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT = excluded.PENDING_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT, PURCHASABLE = excluded.PURCHASABLE, EXCLUSION_REASON = excluded.EXCLUSION_REASON, LAST_SELECTED_AT = excluded.LAST_SELECTED_AT, LAST_BUY_SUCCESS_AT = excluded.LAST_BUY_SUCCESS_AT, RETRY_AFTER = excluded.RETRY_AFTER, EVALUATED_AT = excluded.EVALUATED_AT, UPDATED_AT = excluded.UPDATED_AT
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM STOCK_DASHBOARD WHERE TYPE = 'DOMESTIC' AND (#{marketCode} = 'ALL' OR MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode}) AND EVALUATED_AT != #{evaluatedAt} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM POSITIONS p WHERE p.STOCK_CODE = STOCK_DASHBOARD.SYMBOL AND p.ACTIVE = 'Y' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDERS o WHERE o.STOCK_CODE = STOCK_DASHBOARD.SYMBOL AND o.ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING') )
mapper.select: SELECT RANK_NO AS rankNo, SYMBOL, STOCK_NAME AS stockName, MARKET_CODE AS marketCode, CANDIDATE_SCORE AS candidateScore, PURCHASE_ZONE AS purchaseZone, DASHBOARD_STATUS AS dashboardStatus, LAST_PRICE AS lastPrice, COMPLETED_BUY_COUNT AS completedBuyCount, PENDING_BUY_COUNT AS pendingBuyCount, RESERVED_BUY_COUNT AS reservedBuyCount, CURRENT_DUPLICATE_COUNT AS currentDuplicateCount, MAXIMUM_DUPLICATE_COUNT AS maximumDuplicateCount, REMAINING_DUPLICATE_COUNT AS remainingDuplicateCount, TOTAL_INVESTED_AMOUNT AS totalInvestedAmount, PENDING_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT AS pendingInvestmentAmount, CASE WHEN PURCHASABLE = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PURCHASABLE, EXCLUSION_REASON AS exclusionReason, LAST_SELECTED_AT AS lastSelectedAt, LAST_BUY_SUCCESS_AT AS lastBuySuccessAt, RETRY_AFTER AS retryAfter, EVALUATED_AT AS evaluatedAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM STOCK_DASHBOARD WHERE TYPE = 'DOMESTIC' AND (#{marketCode} = 'ALL' OR MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode}) ORDER BY RANK_NO ASC, SYMBOL ASC

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POSITIONS WHERE ACTIVE = 'Y'), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_TYPE = 'BUY' AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('ORDERING', 'REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING')), 0)
